scope: Task 1 - visual asset audit and behavior baseline

tokenStatus.typographyOwner: src/NovelSpeaker.App/Shared/Theming/Resources/SemanticStyles.xaml; pages consume the text-level styles rather than defining a parallel font stack

runtimeAssets.migrationTarget: Shared dialog semantic shell; retain AppDialogService as the single owner and keep MessageBox only as the no-host fallback. The shell must expose semantic Primary, Secondary and Close actions without moving decision state into XAML.
Shared danger-confirmation dialog style owned by the dialog layer; preserve the external-file safety copy, cache checkbox and current-playback warning.
Shared form-dialog content and input resources; preserve the selected encoding and cancellation result contract.
Shared progress-dialog shell and ProgressBar semantic style; preserve owned cancellation, progress projection and operation completion semantics.

Bootstrap-only failure surface; route recoverable startup errors through the shared notification/dialog layer when a host exists, while retaining a native MessageBox for failures before the visual host is available.
Shared FlyoutSurface style with a tokenized medium elevation and list-row state; retain ShellActiveCacheController as the state owner.
Shared FlyoutSurface, FlyoutItem and input resources; keep timer, rule, speed and volume state in PlayerViewModel/controllers.
Shared HelpDrawer surface and overlay semantic resources; preserve each page's existing open/close binding and help text ownership.
Shared Snackbar semantic presenter resources with one queue owner; retain AppNotificationService as the only application notification adapter.
Shared Menu and MenuItem semantic styles; retain existing code-behind event bridges only for menu placement and command dispatch.

themeEntry.initialDictionary: src/NovelSpeaker.App/Bootstrap/App.xaml: ThemeResources.xaml (initial Palette.Light.xaml) plus Wpf.Ui ThemesDictionary Theme=Light
themeEntry.themeResourceProvider: Application-owned ThemeResources.xaml with Palette.Light.xaml/Palette.Dark.xaml; Wpf.Ui ThemesDictionary and ControlsDictionary remain the control provider
themeEntry.runtimeReplacement: src/NovelSpeaker.App/Shared/Theming/WpfUiThemeRuntime.cs via ApplicationThemeManager.Apply/ApplySystemTheme and ThemePaletteRuntime replacement inside ThemeResources.xaml
themeEntry.accentSource: Application-owned Palette.Light.xaml and Palette.Dark.xaml expose AccentBrush, AccentHoverBrush, AccentPressedBrush, AccentSubtleBrush, AccentSubtleHoverBrush, AccentFocusRingBrush and AccentForegroundBrush; Wpf.Ui remains the control-template provider.
themeEntry.synchronization: ThemePaletteRuntime replaces semantic entries in the stable ThemeResources.xaml dictionary, so DynamicResource references in existing windows, popups and MiniPlayerWindow refresh without rebuilding their visual trees.
themeEntry.fallback: ThemePaletteRuntime validates both palette key sets and falls back to a valid Light palette or the existing valid palette; src/NovelSpeaker.App/Bootstrap/WpfStartupRuntime.cs still applies System through AppThemeStartupCoordinator when the startup theme stage fails.

migrationFindings.current: Pages and SemanticStyles consume application-owned semantic Brush keys through ThemeResources.xaml and matching Palette.Light.xaml/Palette.Dark.xaml dictionaries; Wpf.Ui color names remain behind the control/theme provider boundary.
migrationFindings.migrationTarget: Create app-owned Palette.Light.xaml, Palette.Dark.xaml and ThemeResources.xaml. Map all page/control color use to AppBackground, CanvasSurface, PrimarySurface, SecondarySurface, RaisedSurface, text, border, Accent, state and focus semantic keys. Keep Wpf.Ui as the platform theme provider behind the mapping, not as a page-facing contract.

migrationFindings.current: MainWindow active-cache rows, PlayerView chapter/segment states, CacheManagement selected chapters, BookDetails current chapter and MiniPlayer topmost state use application semantic brushes in local triggers.
migrationFindings.migrationTarget: Move these triggers to shared semantic selected/current/active/focus styles in Components/ListsAndCards.xaml, Components/MediaControls.xaml and Components/Windows/MiniPlayer.xaml; retain only behavior/state bindings at the page call sites.

migrationFindings.current: GeneratedBookCover creates content-specific gradient, accent and foreground brushes in BookCoverGenerator/GeneratedBookCover and BookCoverView binds them directly.
migrationFindings.migrationTarget: Keep the deterministic cover palette as a dedicated BookCover visual asset boundary. Give its surface/foreground contract named cover resources or a dedicated component style; do not merge generated cover colors into the global Accent palette.

migrationFindings.current: Public Popup, playback-list, toolbar-pill, media-button, card and detail-page corner radii are now owned by DesignTokens.xaml and consumed by SemanticStyles.xaml, MainWindow.xaml, MiniPlayerWindow.xaml, PlayerView.xaml, BookDetailsPage.xaml and BookCardView.xaml. BookCoverView.xaml still has a one-off CornerRadius=12 for cover geometry.
migrationFindings.migrationTarget: Keep the existing Card/Dialog/List/Toolbar/Media/Interactive token families as the single public owners. If the MiniPlayer outer surface or cover surface later needs a public radius, assign it to the corresponding window or cover component; do not reintroduce page literals.

migrationFindings.current: MiniPlayerWindow has a transparent Window and an AppBackgroundBrush Border without an outer CornerRadius, despite being a borderless auxiliary window.
migrationFindings.migrationTarget: Add the MiniPlayerSurface style in Windows/MiniPlayer.xaml using the shared MiniPlayerCornerRadius token and preserve the existing transparent-window hit-test/drag behavior.

migrationFindings.current: DesignTokens.xaml defines application-owned ElevationLow, ElevationMedium and ElevationHigh DropShadowEffect resources with low-opacity visual-system parameters. No ordinary static card or all Popup surfaces currently consume them; existing depth remains platform/control-surface managed.
migrationFindings.migrationTarget: Keep ElevationLow, ElevationMedium and ElevationHigh in DesignTokens.xaml and later map them only from shared Flyout, Dialog and MiniPlayer surface owners. Do not add page-local effects or claim ordinary cards are elevated until a shared surface consumes the resource.

migrationFindings.current: SemanticStyles.xaml still owns IconButtonControlTemplate, MediaIconButtonControlTemplate and BorderlessListItemButtonControlTemplate, with repeated hover, pressed, keyboard-focus and disabled triggers. Task 3 migrated public button heights, padding, corners, borders and focus-ring thickness; BookCardView and TtsRulesPage still add local derived Button styles for reveal/current-rule behavior.
migrationFindings.migrationTarget: Move the three templates and their named semantic styles into Components/Buttons.xaml; add named RevealMoreIconButtonStyle and CurrentRuleActionButtonStyle for the two local behavior wrappers, leaving only bindings/triggers that represent their state.

migrationFindings.current: No application-owned TextBox or PasswordBox ControlTemplate exists. Task 3 migrated shared control heights and field spacing, while one-off text-field geometry and the Wpf.Ui base template remain at page call sites.
migrationFindings.migrationTarget: Create the shared Inputs.xaml TextBox/PasswordBox/ComboBox semantic styles and templates in the input-component wave; migrate page-local height, focus, error and disabled visuals to those styles while preserving field bindings and keyboard handling.

migrationFindings.current: SemanticStyles.xaml owns PlaybackProgressSliderStyle plus PlaybackSliderTrackButtonStyle and PlaybackSliderThumbStyle. Task 3 migrated shared progress-track, thumb, media-control and icon dimensions; PlayerView and MiniPlayerWindow still reuse the slider for segment progress and volume, while ProgressBar uses a separate shared PlaybackProgressBarStyle.
migrationFindings.migrationTarget: Move the slider/progress templates to Components/MediaControls.xaml, add explicit hover/focus/dragging Thumb states and semantic ProgressTrack/ProgressFill resources, and keep one template for both playback and volume sliders.

migrationFindings.current: BookDetailsPage still defines an inline ListBoxItem style and ContentPresenter-only ControlTemplate, then applies shared CurrentListItemContainerStyle to the data border. Public list row dimensions, corners and spacing are tokenized.
migrationFindings.migrationTarget: Add a shared VirtualizedListItemContainerStyle with ContentPresenter-only behavior and use CurrentListItemContainerStyle for current-state visuals; keep chapter navigation and locator behavior in existing controllers.

migrationFindings.current: CacheManagementPage still defines an inline ListBoxItem style/ContentTemplate, binds IsSelected one-way to the selection view model and repeats selected-border trigger visuals in the item template. Public list and action dimensions are tokenized.
migrationFindings.migrationTarget: Use a shared ExtendedSelectionListItemContainerStyle plus SelectedCardContainerStyle/SelectableCardListItemContainerStyle; keep DesktopSelectionController and IsSelected projection as the only selection facts.

migrationFindings.current: RegexReplacementRulesPage defines an inline ListBoxItem style/ContentTemplate; ChapterRulesPage and TtsRulesPage use separate local card/triggers for drag target, current rule and enabled state. Their public field, list and toolbar spacing now references DesignTokens.xaml.
migrationFindings.migrationTarget: Add shared RuleWorkbenchListItemContainerStyle, DropTargetListItemContainerStyle and CurrentRuleActionStyle in Components/ListsAndCards.xaml; preserve rule ordering code-behind only as the existing drag/menu event bridge.

migrationFindings.current: PlayerView defines separate inline ListBoxItem styles for the chapter catalog and segment list, plus local current/active-cache-selected border triggers and a separate current-segment text-weight trigger. Public row corners, dimensions and action spacing are tokenized.
migrationFindings.migrationTarget: Add shared PlaybackChapterListItemStyle, PlaybackSegmentListItemStyle and combined CurrentAndSelectedStateStyle in Components/ListsAndCards.xaml; keep IsCurrent, IsSelectedForActiveCache and VisualOpacity as semantic presentation inputs from PlayerViewModel.

migrationFindings.current: MainWindow ActiveCacheFlyout defines an inline ListBoxItem container and Border style with current and failed backgrounds.
migrationFindings.migrationTarget: Use shared FlyoutListItemStyle and ActiveCacheStatusStyle with semantic Current and ErrorSubtle brushes; keep only IsCurrent/IsFailed bindings in the Shell template.

migrationFindings.current: PlayerView, MiniPlayerWindow, TtsRulesPage, ChapterRulesPage and RegexReplacementRulesPage still place PopupSurfaceBorderStyle at their call sites. Shared corners, borders, dimensions and public spacing are tokenized, while page-specific widths and one-off content layout remain; Elevation resources are not yet applied to these surfaces.
migrationFindings.migrationTarget: Keep widths as content-specific layout inputs, but move RaisedSurface background, border, corner radius and ElevationMedium to a shared FlyoutSurface style; use DialogSurface/ElevationHigh for ContentDialog and MiniPlayer.

migrationFindings.current: Settings pages consistently use SettingsRowsGroupBorderStyle, SettingsRowBorderStyle, SettingsLastRowBorderStyle and SettingsNavigationRowButtonStyle; the semantic styles already own their visual state and pages do not add hover setters.
migrationFindings.migrationTarget: Retain the four setting-row semantic styles as the single owner; migrate their Wpf.Ui color references to ThemeResources and add an explicit shared SettingGroup surface token without reintroducing page-local row borders.

behaviorBaseline.observableContract: Primary navigation exposes only Library and Settings; initial navigation targets Library; switching leaves one active item; guarded close can keep the window open.
Library search/import/empty states remain accessible; book details keep virtualized chapter navigation, current locator and unsaved metadata save/discard/cancel behavior.

Playback controls expose command enablement and automation names; chapter/segment lists remain virtualized; progress interaction, current-item locator and Space/Ctrl/Alt shortcuts retain their mappings.
Cache management keeps one selected book, extended chapter selection and Ctrl/Shift/Ctrl+A semantics; cleanup/export enablement, progress, cancel and open-directory feedback remain stable.
TTS, chapter and regex rule workbenches retain split scrollable layout, enable/current state, drag/menu actions, dirty save/cancel enablement and help drawer behavior.

Settings home and subpage rows keep navigation/automation structure; ordinary settings save by field policy; theme selection applies Light/Dark/System at runtime and rolls back on persistence failure.
Mini-player close restores the main window, blank-surface dragging excludes controls, media/volume/progress controls retain names and bindings; dialogs and snackbar notifications remain centralized.
